correctness.rationale: Both independently coded exhaustive face-enumeration methods reproduce all 4680 cells; all signed boundary-squared tests vanish; the 360 explicitly checked free-face collapses leave four two-dimensional components. Every remaining edge has two faces, every vertex link is one circle and orientations glue coherently. With per-component (225,495,270) cells, chi=0 and the surface classification proves each component is a torus. The full standard-library verifier and its expected output are embedded. No infinite conjecture is claimed.

value.rationale: A canonical primitive nine-point Paley/rook strongly regular graph provides a natural first test beyond recent square-free-codomain homotopy classification. Four complete genus-one components, proved by explicit collapses, constitute a precise integral homotopy benchmark with nontrivial pi1 and H2, not merely a small Betti-table increment; the calculation is reproducible and not a routine consequence of the cited theorems.
